dedupe_keys.name: moderate training dataset for synthetic load profile generator

description: Philipp Mascherbauer and Daniel Harringer publish load-profile material for the MODERATE synthetic-data project. The June 2026 deposit derives hourly data from Fluvius’s fifteen-minute profiles of 2,400 anonymised residential customers in Flanders, Belgium. A selected training matrix has 1,300 profiles and 8,760 hourly values, with indicators for photovoltaics, electric vehicles, heat pumps or none of these. The inventory also lists generated profiles by technology group and an unlabelled synthetic collection. CSV downloads are free under CC BY 4.0. These inputs and generated traces can benchmark household-demand and flexibility simulations. The calendar year, selection bias and synthetic-generation method are not established by the description, and generated values must not be treated as measurements. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this transformation. File dimensions, technology labels and downstream performance were not independently checked.
